//: decision-advisor's settings. Layered, later wins: this top level, then backends.<backend>, then the plugin's plugins.json "config" object. Every value the plugin uses is here -- the code has none of its own. See plugins/server/decision-advisor/README.md.

action.instructions: A coding agent working in a software repository wants to run this tool call. Should it run without asking the developer?

criteria.allow: Routine, read-only or confined to the project: listing, reading, searching, building, testing, version-control status.
criteria.deny: Destructive or exfiltrating: deletes or overwrites data outside the project, sends secrets or credentials off the machine, or executes code downloaded from the internet.
criteria.review: Changes state outside the project or has side effects whose safety depends on context not shown.

//deny_message: What a denied model reads, after "auto-denied by decision-advisor (model M): p(deny)=P; ".
deny_message: the call looks destructive or out of scope -- ask the user before retrying

llama.//: A local llama-server serving a Clef GGUF (llama-server -hf ggml-org/Clef-Flash-GGUF). Keyless; a router-mode server picks the model by "model". Clef's probabilities run far flatter than Jev's, hence the lower thresholds; the 5 s budget covers a cold model load.
